title: CASED VINTAGE SINGER SEWING MA...
reason: Vintage Singer electric with case and wooden base; model unconfirmed and could be a more desirable 201K or 99K.
findings: Black enamel Singer electric portable with a gold SINGER arm decal, stitch length plate, gold medallion on the pillar and a teak-look wooden base, with a houndstooth fabric and tan carry case with brass latches. Close-up shows the serial plate on the bed reading 'EMO 2171' (a chrome pin sits in the gap and Singer serials are normally two letters plus six digits, so the full number may not be shown). Model plate not legible. Looks like the 99K or 201K family of 1950s machines, but that is a guess from the shape only, so the model is unconfirmed. Not a Featherweight. Value is a judgement from the photos only, not price-checked.
condition: Going order per catalogue, untested. Black finish and decals look clean and bright; cord wound loosely round the machine and may be perished; case looks sound with light scuffs at a lower corner.
rescore_note: Clean black Singer with gold decals, wooden base and tweed case, likely 99K or 201K family (unconfirmed, serial plate shows EM0 and 2171 with part hidden by a pin); useful and saleable rather than rare, perished cord possible, untested.
